On a computer, open platform.tuya.com and create a free developer account (Individual is enough).
Cloud → Development → Create Cloud Project. Data center: Central Europe for Turkey and Europe. On the next page press Authorize without changing anything.
In the project: Devices → Link App Account → Add App Account → Tuya App Account Authorization. Scan the QR code with the Smart Life app on your phone (Me → scan icon at the top right) and confirm.
Message Service tab: turn the service on, then Messaging Rules → Production Environment → Create Messaging Rules. After saving, turn the rule\'s own switch on (the most often forgotten step).
Overview tab: copy the Access ID and the Access Secret (press the eye icon to reveal the secret).
Paste them here, choose the data center and press Connect. The keys you use in SwitchGuard on your phone work here too.
Create a separate eWeLink account for this computer (in the eWeLink app) and share your devices with it. If this computer used your phone\'s account, the phone would be signed out.
Sign in to dev.ewelink.cc with that account → Console. If it is not a developer yet: Apply now → Individual developers, then wait for eWeLink\'s approval.
Once approved: App List → Create. Redirect URL must be exactly https://127.0.0.1 (no slash at the end).
In App List press View on your app and copy the APPID and the APP SECRET (eye icon).
Here, paste them into API credentials, choose the region and save.
Press Sign in and sign in in the browser. The \"can\'t connect\" page that follows is expected: copy the address from the address bar and SwitchGuard picks it up by itself.
Double-click the setup file (SwitchGuard-…-Kurulum.exe). It does not ask for administrator rights and installs in a few seconds.
If Windows says \"Windows protected your PC\" (SmartScreen), press More info → Run anyway. The app is not signed yet; that is why it warns.
SwitchGuard is installed in your user folder (AppData › Local › SwitchGuard) and adds shortcuts to the desktop and the Start menu.
It starts by itself in the tray (next to the clock) when you sign in to Windows. Closing the window does not stop it; to quit, use the tray icon → Exit.
Add your accounts in Settings → Account (the Tuya and eWeLink steps are below).
Moving to another computer: on the old one, Settings → Backup → Back up to a file; install on the new one, Restore from a file, then sign in to eWeLink again.
To uninstall: Windows Settings → Apps → Installed apps → SwitchGuard → Uninstall.
Remove the Tuya connection? Tuya devices will no longer be monitored on this computer.
Tuya live updates on this computer
Off: Tuya devices are checked every 5 minutes
